launches.title: NOX METALS: The modern metals supplier.
launches.tagline: Modern metals factories to supply America's industrial base.
launches.body:
**NOX METALS: The Factory is the Product**\
Vertically integrated, automated metals factories built to move at software speed.

**TL;DR:** Nox Metals is building the metals processing platform of the future. Our vertically integrated factories run on software and automation to deliver lightning-fast, low-cost metal to our customers. Our goal: power the next industrial era by becoming the fastest, most advanced supplier to America’s industrial base.

Launch Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X6qMjj4RMBQ

## 🛑 The Problem

Every part, from aerospace components to automotive tooling, starts with raw metal. But the supply chain that delivers it hasn’t changed in decades:

* **3–5 days** to get a quote from a broker.
* **Multiple markups** between the mill and your shop.
* **Slow fulfillment** with no visibility once you order.
* **High overhead** baked into every part because of manual, fragmented workflows.

This slows down factories, raises costs, and makes American manufacturing less competitive.

## ⚡ The Nox Metals Model

We don’t just _use_ factories, we build them to be the product.

* **Orders in → Machines moving:** Your quote instantly becomes a job on our automated cutting line.
* **Software + Automation:** Robots pick, cut, package, and label… removing human bottlenecks.
* **Lower Overhead:** No layers of brokers, reps, and schedulers.
* **Faster for You:** Shorter lead times, real-time tracking, and predictable delivery.

Lower overhead means better prices. Faster cycle times mean more throughput for your factory.

## 📈 Why It Works for Customers

* **Time:** Place orders in minutes, get delivery in days.
* **Cost:** Reduced overhead on our end means better pricing for you.
* **Certainty:** Every order tracked from quote to delivery.

## 🛠 Who We Serve

* Job Shops
* OEMs
* Tier 1/2/3 Suppliers
* Aerospace, Defense, and Industrial Manufacturers

## 💬 Ask

We’re live with aluminum plate and block today, expanding into steel, tube, and sheet next. If you run a factory and need raw metal faster and cheaper, let’s talk.

📩 zane@noxmetals.co\
🌐 [noxmetals.co](http://noxmetals.co)

When your factory needs metal, ours is already working.
